Lena: Quick async check — final gating for Optimize toolkit delivery: we need signoff on quantization recommendations and batching/caching defaults. Can owners call out blockers? ETA for locking configs before next deploy is EOD Thu. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Raj: I'm owning quant recs. Running full eval sweep tonight, but I saw a small regression on long-form summarization with int8 on model-redwood-v2. Need to tune per-layer quant schedule. PR incoming.

Maya: Noted. For runtime, batching policy default needs min_batch=2, max_latency_ms=50. Also adding KV cache warmup flag. Can we agree on defaults or do per-model?

Alex P: From platform side, we need the exact config JSON + release note to land canary. Also need a dependency from eng-sre: a new instance profile for dedicated capacity.

Chris: eng-sre will provision the instance profile once we have the expected peak tokens/sec and memory footprint. Raj, can you paste rough numbers?

Raj: Peak ~ 35k tokens/sec on s-8x (with batch sizes ~8). Memory ~ 36GB GPU per shard after q4 quant. Details in PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize-toolkit/pull/2123

Jules: QA caught a regression alert on two prompt families — precision drop ~2.6% top-1 on summarization. Regression alert ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/OPT-549

Lena: Thanks. Raj can you add fallback policy (roll back to fp16) when eval score delta > 2%? That'll be our automatic guard.

Raj: Yup will add automatic rollback + metric tag.

Alex P: Quick CR ping @Maya, @Chris — PR needs a runtime config schema bump and infra tag. Can we merge by tomorrow morning? :pray:

Maya: I'll review tonight. If I don't see blockers I'll approve.

Chris: I'll queue infra once we get the numbers. FYI: deploy-bot will run a canary with 10% traffic for 4 hours then auto-promote if no errors.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: optimize-toolkit/quant-batch-v3 -> 10% traffic -> 4h. Monitor paths: /generate, /chat, /embed

Lena: Cool. Action items: (1) Raj -> push PR with rollback + per-layer schedule (2) Maya -> review runtime config (3) Chris -> provision instance profile after numbers (4) Jules -> run regression followup. Marking owners. I'll check back EOD Thu. :white_check_mark:
